rules.notes: The current §903.03 table has one minimum lot size and no per-unit lot area row. The 2024 DCP draft struck the per-unit rows, and the section history cites Ord. 10-2025 (eff. 5-7-2025). Side setback shown is the minimum interior side yard; minimum exterior (street) side yard is 25 ft. Interior side setback is zero on a party-wall side for attached units (§903.03.C.2). Single-Unit Attached Residential is P. New multi-unit buildings of 4+ units need Site Plan Review (§903.02.E.2; §922.04.A.5). Parking minimum is 1 per unit for single-unit detached/two/three/multi-unit (0 for single-unit attached); a maximum also applies. §914.02.A Schedule A. Contextual side (min 3 ft), rear and height are also allowed (§925.06.C, §925.06.I, §925.07.D). The code sets no FAR or lot coverage in residential districts. Ch. 915/906 overlays can add limits.

newCompsSf.note: Search widened to 3 mi (0 within 0.25 mi; 0 within 0.5 mi; 0 within 1 mi; 7 within 2 mi; 29 within 3 mi).
newCompsSf.rule: Valid arm's-length sales in the last 3 years of homes built no more than 10 years before the sale year, at least 600 sq ft of living area and $20,000. Same City neighborhood (or municipality) when it has at least 5 such sales, otherwise the nearest by distance; widen from ¼ mile to 3 miles until 8, keep the nearest 12; drop sales beyond 1.5× the middle-half spread of $/SF; at least 5 needed.

selection.receipt: Rule: sales in the same neighborhood (or municipality) when it has 5+; otherwise sales from areas in the same market tier, else the nearest by distance; widen until 8, keep the nearest 12; drop sales beyond 1.5× the middle-half spread of $/SF. Market tier: Crawford-Roberts existing homes sell for a median $191/SF; comps were limited to areas within ±35% ($124–$258/SF; Assumption, edit me): Central Northside, Duquesne Heights, East Allegheny, Hazelwood, Mount Washington, Polish Hill, South Side Flats. Result: 12 sales from the areas in the same market tier, nearest first, in Central Northside, Duquesne Heights, East Allegheny, Mount Washington, Polish Hill, South Side Flats; median $277/SF, middle half $235–$300/SF.
